service_ports.description: Array of (backend) ports for the service (target_port in k8s service configuration)

port.description: Port Number (integer 0-65535 or -1 for any port).

node_port.description: Port Number (integer 0-65535) of the node port.

external_traffic_policy.description: External traffic policy configured for this service. This determines whether traffic is forwarding between nodes to find a backing pod.

consumer_ports.description: Array of (client) ports (1-65535) for the service (port in k8s service configuration)

ip_addresses.description: Array of IPs or CIDRs for the service
